disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.p1: Doz is only a decision-support tool for physicians and pharmacists. It does not replace clinical judgment, official prescribing information or local guidelines.
disclaimer.p2: The data is under clinical review. Drugs marked "Unverified" have not yet been signed off by a clinical reviewer.
disclaimer.p3: Every number is shown with its source. Before prescribing, check the dose against the original source and the patient's condition.
disclaimer.p4: No patient data is stored or sent anywhere. Responsibility for prescribing lies with the treating physician.
disclaimer.agree: I understand this is only a support tool and that clinical decisions are my responsibility.
disclaimer.short: Doz is only a support tool and does not replace clinical judgment or official sources. Check every dose against the original source before prescribing.

calc.title: Dose calculator
calc.warnBody: This calculation is based on online sources (official product labels and the references cited) and may contain errors. Taking medicines without approval from a supervising physician can be fatal. This tool is only an aid for physicians; check the dose against the original source and the patient’s condition before prescribing.
calc.rangeNote: The source gives a dose range: the first number is the lower end, the second the upper end.
calc.enterAge: Enter age (weight is optional for this regimen).
calc.vialNote: Reconstitute the vial per the label and work out the volume from the final concentration.
calc.infusionNote: The rate is for the selected diluted concentration. If your dilution differs, choose the matching preparation. Titrate to clinical response.

engine.FORMULATION_NOT_ALLOWED: This formulation is not allowed for this regimen.

sources.title: Sources
sources.policy: Every dose, warning and note in Doz is cited to a specific source with a section or page. Sources are official FDA labels on DailyMed, published guidelines and (once licensed) the medical school's licensed reference. Anything that cannot be verified is not entered.
sources.noneOfType: No sources of this type recorded yet.

about.title: About Doz and how to use it safely
about.description: What Doz is, how to use it and where the data comes from.
about.how1: Search for a drug or pick it from a category.
about.how3: Choose the available formulation (suspension strength or tablet).
about.how4: Enter the patient's age and weight; Persian digits are accepted.
about.how5: Read the result and tap any source chip to see the section, page and link of the original source, and check the dose against it.
about.whatBody: A drug dose calculator for children and all ages that shows a specific source for every number, warning and note. Per-dose and daily maximums are applied, and age-based contraindications stop the calculation.
about.refsTitle: Sources and the reference status table
about.refsBody: Each drug page has a table showing which sources (FDA label, guideline, the medical school's licensed reference, Iranian leaflet) have references recorded (✅) and which do not (❌). Anything without a source is shown with a red "No reference" label.
about.reviewBody: Every drug starts as "Unverified" and becomes "Verified" only after a named clinical reviewer checks and signs it off with a date.
about.privacyBody: Doz has no server or accounts. Age, weight and other inputs are calculated only in your browser and are never sent anywhere.
about.contribBody: The data are JSON files in the project's GitHub repository and are validated and tested automatically before publishing. The guide for adding drugs is docs/DATA_GUIDE.md.

quick.safety: This is only a calculation aid. All liquid amounts are given in millilitres (mL); measure only with the oral syringe or dosing cup supplied, never a household spoon.

quick.notListed: Only drugs whose dose can be calculated in this mode are listed. Drugs with individualised dosing (e.g. warfarin, insulin, prednisone) or only calculable in the other mode are not here; use search or the drug page.
